steps.what: Select the actual working drawing revision, copy scale, sheets and reproduction settings; check the complete copy job
inputs: actual working drawing originals and required copies
actual copier or drawing-reproduction equipment and job requirements
outputs: exact checked drawing originals and reproduction job settings

steps.what: Reproduce working drawings on copy machines or trace drawings in ink using the checked originals, scale and settings
inputs: exact checked drawing originals and reproduction job settings
actual paper, ink and reproduction equipment
outputs: actual reproduced or ink-traced working drawings

steps.what: Inspect actual reproduced sheets for line completeness, legibility, scale and revision errors and correct failed copies or tracing
inputs: actual reproduced or ink-traced working drawings
actual working drawing originals and required copies
outputs: checked usable drawing reproductions and identified rejected sheets

tasks.design: Use the existing drawing copier and its scale/quality settings in {OPS_SYSTEM}, the drawing-reproduction equipment interface. No additional saving is claimed where copying already uses that equipment; physical ink tracing remains manual unless the actual source and accepted reproduction method change.
tasks.previous_blocker: An original may be physical and reproduction quality must be checked against it.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing copier settings already provide the basic reproduction capability.
tasks.still_hard: Faint lines, scale errors and old originals require direct inspection.
tasks.human_edge: Recognize a missing connection or illegible reference on the actual copy.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: drawing copying is already mechanized and physical ink tracing and copy-quality inspection remain active work.

assumptions: The actual episode uses the stated copier or ink-tracing method, not a newly invented digital master. No free scanning, vectorization or accepted CAD conversion is assumed.
Actual revision/scale selection and reproduction settings are separated in s1; reproduction is s2 and quality checking s3. There is no separate required report, send or register entry in this task.

Check native batch/scale presets first, but equivalent existing copier functionality earns no additional saving. New scan capture and line verification would need to be counted before proposing conversion.
Shares 30/45/25 are provisional unmeasured active effort. All remain; gross and net saving are zero. No new maintenance is introduced.
The reproduction gate is the checked originals and exact physical job settings in s1. Changes require rechecking before s2; post-copy inspection does not replace that check.
unknowns: Whether actual work is copying or ink tracing and what source masters exist
research_questions: Is physical ink tracing still required, or is an accepted digital master already available?

already_counted.description: Selection, physical reproduction and inspection all remain.

incremental.description: No changed process or new maintenance proposed.

approvals.approved_version: exact checked drawing originals and reproduction job settings

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Existing copying equipment is already today's baseline; no measured or supported additional reduction.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Prepare the actual final layout's layer, polarity, scale and output mapping in PCB/CAM output software (OPS_SYSTEM)
inputs: actual final layout revision
actual production layer and tape/film output requirements
outputs: prepared final-layout production output job and mapping

steps.what: Check the complete output job against the final layout, intended layers, scale, polarity, format and destination
inputs: prepared final-layout production output job and mapping
actual final layout revision
actual production layer and tape/film output requirements
outputs: exact checked final-layout output job and production-media destination

steps.what: Generate computer tapes of final layout design to produce layered photo masks or photo plotting design onto film with the checked output job
inputs: exact checked final-layout output job and production-media destination
outputs: generated actual final-layout production media and output receipt

tasks.design: Configure a native checked output-job profile in {OPS_SYSTEM}, the actual PCB/CAM tape or photoplot production interface, to reuse stable layer and format mappings. The drafter checks the complete instantiated job against the real final revision before generating the media; existing generation runtime earns no saving.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated manual output mappings can introduce layer or polarity mistakes.
tasks.enabler_now: CAM output profiles can retain explicit production settings.
tasks.still_hard: The accepted legacy format, actual layout revision and manufacturing layer conventions must agree.
tasks.human_edge: Detect a plausible-looking output job for the wrong revision or layer stack.

ambition.what: Reduce repeated preparation of actual production output jobs.

build_days.consent_and_access: 1-3 with the CAM owner and production data custodian

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: CAM output-job profiles can reuse layer/format settings while final layout and production-media checks remain necessary.

assumptions: Actual layout designers supply the final layout; production supplies real accepted tape/film requirements. The drafter captures and reconciles those mappings in s1. No accepted modern replacement for legacy media is invented.
Only stable mappings are reused; missing requirements or changed layer stacks stop for manual preparation and checking. Existing equivalent profiles remove the gain.

Shares 45/54/1 are provisional unmeasured active effort. Gross saving 45 times 0.40 = 18; 2 hours of profile upkeep leaves 16 net. Generation runtime is already mechanized, negligible and fully retained.
The exact final job exists before s2 checks it. Changed layout, mapping or destination invalidates the gate. No hidden production release or external send is promised.
unknowns: Actual legacy interface and existing profile reuse
research_questions: Which output-job fields are still re-entered for recurring layouts?

already_counted.description: Actual requirements capture and complete output-job verification remain.

incremental.description: Maintain and verify production output profiles when formats change.

approvals.approved_version: exact checked final-layout output job and production-media destination

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 unmeasured range below provisional 16 percent net, conditional on repeated manual output preparation.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Determine the order of work from actual electrical drafting deliverables, dependencies and installation or manufacturing needs
inputs: actual drawing brief, engineering requirements and dependencies
outputs: drafter's selected work order and dependency reasoning

steps.what: Determine the method of presentation, such as orthographic or isometric drawing, for the actual equipment and drawing audience
inputs: actual drawing brief, engineering requirements and dependencies
actual equipment geometry and intended manufacturing or installation audience
outputs: drafter's chosen drawing presentation and limits

tasks.design: Keep work sequencing and orthographic/isometric presentation decisions with the drafter using the actual brief and {OPS_SYSTEM}, the electrical CAD viewer. Native drawing templates assist later drawing production but do not remove this task's decision work.
tasks.previous_blocker: The right sequence and presentation depend on real geometry and deliverable dependencies.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing CAD views already let the drafter inspect alternative presentations.
tasks.still_hard: A convenient view may hide the connection or clearance the recipient needs.
tasks.human_edge: Select views that communicate the intended equipment and construction sequence.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: electrical drawing presentation and task sequencing depend on engineering context and existing CAD views support those decisions.

assumptions: This is determining work order and presentation, not drawing production or a separate planning report. Actual brief lookup is included in s1 and geometry/view lookup in s2.

No required record, report, send or commit is hidden in a meeting. If the actual episode includes a written issued plan or CAD configuration change, decompose that observed work separately rather than inventing it here.
Native templates are checked as an option but affect later production already counted under drawing tasks. There is no new structured geometry or dependency capture assumed.
Shares 55/45 are unmeasured active decision effort; both fully remain. Gross/net savings and new upkeep are zero.
unknowns: Actual repeated decisions versus already fixed drawing conventions
research_questions: Are presentation conventions fixed already or chosen case by case?

already_counted.description: Actual brief/geometry lookup and decisions remain.

incremental.description: No new configuration or maintenance introduced.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: No additional change to actual decision work identified after considering native views and templates.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Visit installation sites and sketch locations

steps.what: Visit proposed installation sites and inspect actual equipment positions, access and location constraints
inputs: actual proposed installation site and drawing brief
actual authorized site access
outputs: drafter's actual observed installation location and constraints

steps.what: Take actual site dimensions and reference points needed for the rough location sketch
inputs: drafter's actual observed installation location and constraints
actual measuring equipment and accessible site features
outputs: drafter-measured site dimensions and reference points with gaps

steps.what: Draw rough sketches of location, enter measured dimensions and check the complete site sketch and intended project revision in mobile electrical CAD (OPS_SYSTEM)
inputs: drafter's actual observed installation location and constraints
drafter-measured site dimensions and reference points with gaps
actual project identifier and existing drafting symbols
outputs: exact checked rough site sketch, measurement gaps and project destination

steps.what: Save the exact checked rough location sketch in its intended internal project revision
inputs: exact checked rough site sketch, measurement gaps and project destination

tasks.design: Use native reusable electrical symbols and project context in {OPS_SYSTEM}, mobile electrical CAD, for the actual rough site sketch. The drafter still visits, measures, draws the real geometry and checks every dimension before saving the sketch.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated standard symbols and project context add handling to rough site sketching.
tasks.enabler_now: Native CAD symbol libraries can reuse fixed drawing elements.
tasks.still_hard: Unseen routes, inaccessible features and ambiguous site references cannot be inferred.
tasks.human_edge: Recognize a site condition that the drawing brief does not reveal.

ambition.what: Reduce repeated fixed drawing elements within actual rough sketches.

build_days.consent_and_access: 1-2 with the site owner and CAD administrator

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native CAD symbols and project templates can reduce repeated drawing elements while site observation and measurement remain physical work.

assumptions: The scenario is an actual digital rough site sketch, not a free conversion from paper. If site sketching must remain on paper or native reuse already exists, the proposed gain is absent.
The drafter produces all observations in s1 and measurements in s2 and captures/checks them in s3. No prepared site model, automatic dimensions or image feed is assumed.
Use only verified fixed symbols and context. Missing measurements remain explicit gaps; no model completes the site's geometry.

Shares 45/20/34/1 are unmeasured provisional active effort. Gross saving 34 times 0.10 = 3.4; 1 hour of symbol upkeep leaves 2.4 net. Same-system save is negligible, fully retained and carries no saving.
Final sketch checking is ordinary authoring in s3, not an added approval process. Edits invalidate the final-version gate.
unknowns: Actual paper versus digital sketching and existing symbol reuse
research_questions: Measure repeated standard drawing elements separately from actual site geometry and dimension entry.

already_counted.description: Actual visits, measurement, sketch capture and checking remain.

incremental.description: Maintain and check the small native site-sketch symbol library.

approvals.approved_version: exact checked rough site sketch, measurement gaps and project destination

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 unmeasured opportunity below provisional 2.4 percent net; actual visits, dimensions and sketch interpretation remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional
